title: Bounded influential coordinates
statement: Let $q$ be a positive integer and let $G$ be a regular unique game over $q$ symbols. Let the table assign to each vertex a function from the Boolean cube $\\{−1,1\\}^{q}$ to $[-1,1]$. For a real parameter $\\varepsilon$ and a vertex $v$, the bounded influential coordinates are those coordinates $i\\in\\{0,\\ldots,q-1\\}$ whose influence in the function assigned to $v$ is at least $\\varepsilon/2$.
hypotheses_covered: A regular unique game with alphabet size $q$
A table of functions on the $q$-dimensional Boolean cube taking values in $[-1,1]$
